intent_record.intent_summary: Fixed race condition in NFC LLCP transmit path by adding proper spinlock synchronization and validating queue state before enqueueing packets
intent_record.what: Added spin_lock/spin_unlock around transmit queue operations, changed skb_queue_tail to __skb_queue_tail, and added a check for empty queue that frees the packet and returns -ENXIO if queue is empty
intent_record.how: Prevents race conditions during concurrent transmit queue access by acquiring the spinlock before queue operations, and prevents sending packets when the queue is unexpectedly empty by freeing the skb and returning an error

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes race condition and list integrity issues during NFC LLCP device removal by serializing tx_queue access and using list_del_init
intent_record.what: Wrapped the list deletion with spin_lock/spin_unlock on local->tx_queue.lock and changed list_del to list_del_init
intent_record.how: Prevents concurrent access to the transmit queue during removal and reinitializes list pointers to avoid dangling references
